# Mermaid renderer corpus

These small fixtures come from Merman v0.8.0, commit
`2029bd547077b1a6800878e125663633d81e6d87`. Merman-origin fixtures are used under MIT; Mermaid-derived
fixtures retain the Mermaid MIT license. Both notices are included beside the
fixtures and recorded in NOTICE. They test Kettle's native measurement and final
SVG-to-pixel integration, content classification and ordered Markdown galleries.
Passing them does not imply pixel parity with a browser or authentic typography
from the synthetic fallback-font fixture.
